rubric.supported: every factual element is stated in or follows directly from the cited passage text
rubric.partially_supported: the core claim is supported, but a detail (number, qualifier, comparison, attribution, extra claim) is not
rubric.not_supported: the main claim is not stated in or entailed by the cited text, or contradicts it

method: four independent labelling passes, one per quarter of the items, each reading only the sentence and the full text of its cited passages (no L4 scores); 10 further (sentence, passage) pairs (x001-x010), where a sentence recurs with a different cited chunk, labelled by the same rubric in a second pass
